title: DevTrace: Lightweight Plug-In Design for PCIe Transaction Tracing in Edge Intelligence Workloads
problem: Host-peripheral interactions during high-load tasks create optimization bottlenecks, with existing tracing tools degrading performance by up to 5.39x.
motivation: Resource-constrained edge intelligence deployments need low-overhead profiling and analysis of peripheral interactions.
method: DevTrace records the data transfers between computers and connected hardware like GPUs or storage devices. Rather than letting recording interrupt the kernel (the core operating system) constantly—which would create huge overhead—it uses a separate recording framework that runs independently. Because it requires only minimal changes to device driver software, it achieves low overhead while avoiding expensive kernel interrupts.
key_novelty: The breakthrough is a lightweight plug-in design that traces any device type while staying independent from the core system.
contributions: 128x reduction in memory usage vs page-fault solutions
10x lower CPU overhead vs page-fault tools
Negligible performance degradation even under high-load
Potential eBPF extensions for further decoupling
limitations: Currently specific to PCIe; general device support requires additional work.
